name: Unseen Strike
body:
Your stealth training allows you to strike more effectively from hiding.

Prerequisites: Shadow level 5th, Stealth 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When you attack a target who is unaware of your presence, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your attack roll. If the attack hits, you also deal an additional 1d6 precision damage. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum 1).
